veld-lc-ladder-enkel.naam: Agility ladder: one foot in each square
veld-lc-ladder-enkel.uitleg: Run through the ladder with small, quick steps: one foot in each square. After the last rung, accelerate 5 m to the cone. Then jog back round the outside and rejoin the back of the queue.
veld-lc-ladder-enkel.organisatie: 4 m agility ladder (9 squares) with the start 1.5 m in front and a cone 5 m beyond it. Players queue in front of the ladder; the next one goes when the player ahead is halfway through.
coachpunten: On the balls of your feet, small quick steps
One foot in each square, don't step on the rungs
Drive your arms
Accelerate explosively after the ladder

makkelijker: Two feet in each square, steady pace
No sprint at the end
moeilijker: Against the clock: who is fastest without mistakes?
After the ladder, control a ball and pass it back
The coach holds up a colour: sprint to that cone

veld-lc-ladder-in-uit.uitleg: Stand beside the ladder facing the coach and move sideways along it: both feet into the square, both feet out, then on to the next square. After the ladder, jog to the cone and back round the outside.
veld-lc-ladder-in-uit.organisatie: 4 m agility ladder. Players queue beside the start of the ladder, on the coach's side. After the ladder, jog 3.5 m to a cone; come back on the other side of the queue.
coachpunten: Hips and shoulders stay facing the coach
Low and light on the balls of your feet
Count out loud: in-in-out-out

makkelijker: Walk it first to learn the rhythm
Only in-in (both feet in every square)
moeilijker: Faster, with active arms
Control a ball after the ladder
Come back in-out going backwards

veld-lc-lage-hordes.uitleg: Run over six low hurdles with one step between each pair. Lift your knee high and put your foot down quickly and actively under your body. After the last hurdle, sprint to the cone and jog back round the outside.
veld-lc-lage-hordes.organisatie: Six low hurdles (15 cm) 80 cm apart, starting 2 m from the start. Cone 5 m after the last hurdle. The next player goes when the one ahead is over the third hurdle.
coachpunten: Knee up, toes pulled up
Land with your foot under your hip, short ground contact
Upright trunk, arms at 90° driving
Accelerate straight after the last hurdle

makkelijker: Hurdles 1 m apart
Sticks flat on the ground instead of hurdles
moeilijker: High hurdles (30 cm)
Sideways over the hurdles
Two contacts between the hurdles, high tempo
After the last hurdle, control a pass from the coach and shoot at a mini goal

veld-lc-slalom.uitleg: Run as tightly as possible round six poles, alternating left and right. After the last pole, accelerate to the cone. Jog back outside the lane.
veld-lc-slalom.organisatie: Six poles in a straight line, 1.5 m apart. Cone 4 m after the last pole. Players queue 2 m in front of the first pole.
coachpunten: Small steps just before the pole, push off with your outside foot
Low centre of gravity in the turn
Stay close to the pole: the shortest route
Accelerate after the last pole

makkelijker: Poles 2 m apart
Steady pace, learn the route first
moeilijker: With a ball: dribble with the inside and outside of the foot
Two lanes side by side: who finishes first?
Back through the slalom going backwards
After the slalom, shoot a ball from the coach first time at goal

veld-lc-t-test.uitleg: Sprint from A to B, side-step to C, then side-step across to D on the other side, back to B, and run backwards to A. Touch each cone with your hand. Keep facing forwards the whole time.
veld-lc-t-test.organisatie: Four cones in a T: A (start) and B 10 m apart; C and D 5 m to the left and right of B. Players take turns; time them to add some competition.
coachpunten: Get low at each cone and touch it
Sideways: don't cross your feet, hips stay facing forwards
Backwards: small steps, weight over your feet

makkelijker: Half distances (5 m and 2.5 m)
No touching the cones
moeilijker: Timed, with a second attempt to beat your time
The coach calls 'left' or 'right' at B (reaction)
After the T-test, sprint to a ball and score in a mini goal

veld-lc-ringen.uitleg: Jump through the rings: in a single ring you land on one foot, where two rings are side by side you land with your feet apart, one in each (like hopscotch). After the last ring, sprint to the cone and jog back.
veld-lc-ringen.organisatie: Rings in a line of about 7 m: single, single, single, double, single, double, single, double. About 90 cm apart. Cone 4 m after the last ring.
coachpunten: Land on the balls of your feet, soft knees
Use your arms to help the take-off
Keep the rhythm: don't stop between rings

makkelijker: Land on two feet in every ring
Rings closer together
moeilijker: Single rings on your weaker leg only
Sideways through the rings
After the last ring, react to a colour from the coach

veld-lc-stokken.naam: Stick run: stride length and frequency
veld-lc-stokken.uitleg: Run over the sticks with exactly one step between each pair. The sticks get slightly further apart, so your stride gets longer and your speed higher. After the last stick, sprint on to the cone.
veld-lc-stokken.organisatie: Seven sticks flat on the ground, across the running direction. Gaps increase from 80 cm to 1.3 m. Cone 4.5 m after the last stick. Jog back round the outside.
coachpunten: Exactly one step between each pair of sticks
Put your foot down actively under your body (not far in front)
Eyes forward, not on your feet
Speed up as the gaps get bigger

makkelijker: All sticks 80 cm apart
Fewer sticks (4)
moeilijker: Gaps up to 1.5 m (for U15+)
Smaller gaps (60 cm) for high frequency
After the sticks, take a ball and score in a mini goal

veld-lc-kleurenreactie.uitleg: Two players stand in the middle facing the coach. The coach calls a colour; both players sprint to that disc cone, touch it and sprint back to the middle. First back wins a point.
veld-lc-kleurenreactie.organisatie: Four coloured disc cones 4 m around a centre point (front, back, left, right). The players stand 1.5–2 m apart in the middle; the coach is 6 m in front of them.
coachpunten: Knees slightly bent, on the balls of your feet: ready to go
Explosive first step in the right direction
Slow down with small steps, touch it low and turn quickly

makkelijker: The coach also points to the colour (see and hear)
Only two colours
moeilijker: The coach calls two colours in a row
"Not red": go to the disc cone opposite red
First to the disc cone gets a ball from the coach: 1v1 on a mini goal

veld-lc-estafette.uitleg: Two teams run a course at the same time: through the ladder (one foot per square), slalom round three poles, round the cone to the right and sprint back outside the lane. Rejoin the back; then the next player goes. Which team gets everyone round first?
veld-lc-estafette.organisatie: Two identical lanes side by side, 7 m apart: 4 m ladder, three poles 1.5 m apart, turning cone 3.5 m further on. Teams queue in front of their own lane.
coachpunten: Technique before speed: a mistake in the ladder means starting it again
Turn tight and low round the cone
Encourage your teammates and rejoin quickly

makkelijker: Only the slalom and the cone
Ladder with two feet per square
moeilijker: With a ball through the slalom
Extra section with low hurdles
Two laps per player
Last section: shoot at a mini goal, only goals count

veld-cv-hordes-sprint-duel.naam: Hurdles, sprint to the ball and 1v1
veld-cv-hordes-sprint-duel.uitleg: Two players go over their own row of hurdles at the same time. At the end the coach plays a ball between them: whoever gets it first attacks one of the two mini goals; the other defends.
veld-cv-hordes-sprint-duel.organisatie: Two rows of four hurdles, 6 m apart. Coach 8 m beyond the hurdles between the two mini goals. Afterwards join the other queue.
coachpunten: Hurdles: quick and precise, don't touch them
Sprint: low start after the last hurdle, watch the ball
Attacker: body between ball and defender; defender: don't dive in

makkelijker: No hurdles, start on a signal
Ball closer to the attacker
moeilijker: Sideways over the hurdles
2v2 with four rows of hurdles
After a goal, a second ball straight away: transition

veld-lc-vallende-pion.naam: Sprint and stop at the falling cone
veld-lc-vallende-pion.uitleg: Two lanes side by side, each with a start gate and a finish gate. In the middle the coach stands with a cone in each hand. Two players sprint at the same time. During the sprint the coach drops one cone: the player on that side brakes as fast as possible and stands still, the other keeps sprinting to the finish.
veld-lc-vallende-pion.organisatie: Two 20 m lanes, 8 m apart, with cones as start and finish gates. The coach stands halfway in the middle, facing the start, holding a cone in each hand. The players line up in two rows behind the start. After their turn they jog back round the outside.
coachpunten: Watch the coach's hands during the sprint
Braking: short steps, weight back and low through the knees
Really stand still, feet shoulder-width apart, before you move off again

makkelijker: Jog first instead of sprinting
The coach calls out the side when dropping the cone
moeilijker: Sometimes the coach drops no cone
After stopping, sprint straight back to the start
Start backwards and then turn round

veld-lc-hordes-zijwaarts-sprint.uitleg: A race between two players, each in their own lane. First straight ahead over the low hurdles, then sideways footwork over three low hurdles (to the left in the left lane, to the right in the right lane), and then sprint straight ahead to the finish. Who gets there first?
veld-lc-hordes-zijwaarts-sprint.organisatie: Two lanes side by side. Per lane: 3 low hurdles in a row, 1 m apart, then 3 low hurdles or cones sideways to the outside, and 9 m further on a finish gate. The players line up in two rows behind the first hurdle and go back round the outside after their turn.
coachpunten: Over the hurdles: knees high and quick, short contacts
Sideways: nose forward, stay low and don't cross your feet
Accelerate straight after the last hurdle: first steps small and powerful

makkelijker: Cones instead of hurdles
No race at first, focus on technique
moeilijker: After the sideways part, receive a ball and finish
The coach calls left or right during the hurdles
Start on a signal with your back to the hurdles

veld-lc-achtjes-drie-pionnen.uitleg: From the start gate, sprint straight ahead to the first station. There are three cones side by side and you run a fixed route. Station 1: come out between the cones, go right round the right cone, through between the two cones and on to the next station. Station 2: right round the middle cone, turn left, round the left cone, through between the middle and left cones and right round the right cone. Station 3: right round the middle cone, left round the left cone, behind the middle cone and right round the right cone. Then sprint to the finish.
veld-lc-achtjes-drie-pionnen.organisatie: Start gate, three stations in a row and a finish, over about 33 m. Each station has three cones 5 m apart (left, middle, right); the stations are 9 m apart. The numbers in the picture show the order at each station. The next player starts when the previous one reaches station 2.
coachpunten: Stay tight round the cone: turn short, low through the knees
Inside foot close to the cone, already look at the next cone
Accelerate between the stations and only brake just before the turn

makkelijker: Learn the route at a jog first
Stations 1 and 2 only
moeilijker: With a ball at your feet
Two players at once, 5 seconds apart
Time it and try to improve
